eli: FYI emerald-int4 canary spike on funcall parse fails for /agent/search. rate 0.7% -> 4.2% after deploy. examples attached.
ben: can you paste an example?
eli: ```{
{"tool":"web_search","args": {"q":"redwood inference intro"}}}
```
ben: looks like trailing suffix and extra comma. suspect int4 token alignment / EOS handling. running quick repro with token dumps.
priya: try disabling kvcache for the canary cohort as a mitigation. also consider a tolerant postprocess healer for immediate traffic.
ravi: we saw this before with quant + kvcache. cheap fix: disable kvcache + batch_size=1.
ben: repro: int8 parse_fail 0.6%, int4 4.0%. int4 + kvcache disabled -> 1.0%. token dump shows extra 502-like token near EOS. sending dumps to infra.
eli: canary-bot: INCIDENT created INC-2026-999 (emerald-int4-parse-spike).
priya: plan: (1) enable healer on cohort B, label healed outputs, (2) disable kvcache for cohort B, (3) open kernel triage. I'll run the structured-eval suite (10k) to measure schema conformance.
ben: pushed healer canary with metrics healer_applied_count and healer_success_rate.
canary-bot: healer deployed to cohort B at 1790001148. monitoring.
priya: initial healer effect: raw 4.0% -> post-healer 2.1% (healer fixed ~47% of failures). keep on for 24h window.
eli: pausing int4 rollout. will sync tomorrow with triage ticket and eval results.
